jobs.title: Senior Director, Pharmacy Experience and Transformation
jobs.description:
**Location:**

243 Consumers Road, Toronto, Ontario, M2J 4W8
At Shoppers Drug Mart, we’re innovating health and wellness in Canada. From prescriptions to walk\-in clinics, and a beloved loyalty program, we’re caring and supporting our customers in new ways every day.  

With more than 1,300 locally owned and operated stores from coast to coast, the Shoppers Drug Mart network is more than a great place to shop, it’s a great place to work. We’re committed to building our talented team who champion collaboration, kindness and inclusivity. Join our team, and help recognize a healthy future for your career and for all Canadians.

**Why this role is important?**


Reporting to the VP, Pharmacy Operations, Clinical Excellence and Transformation, the Senior Director, Pharmacy Experience and Transformation will lead the strategy and execution of transformational initiatives shaping the future of pharmacy at Shoppers Drug Mart.


This role will own the **pharmacy AI, technology, automation and optimization agenda**, while ensuring that the patient and pharmacy team experience remains at the centre of transformation. The successful candidate will identify and scale opportunities that improve how patients access and experience pharmacy care, simplify pharmacy workflows, enhance team member experience and deliver measurable operational and business value.


Working closely with Pharmacy Operations, Technology, Digital, Clinical Excellence, and other cross\-functional partners, this leader will translate emerging capabilities, patient and team insights, and business opportunities into a clear transformation strategy and roadmap. They will be comfortable operating at both the strategic and execution level, taking initiatives from early\-stage discovery and business case development through implementation, adoption, and scale.

 **What You’ll Do**

* Define and lead the Pharmacy Experience and Transformation strategy and roadmap, with a strong focus on AI, automation, technology and the evolving needs of patients and pharmacy teams.
* Own the pharmacy AI agenda, identifying and prioritizing opportunities to apply AI and emerging technologies to improve patient experience, pharmacy workflows, team member experience and operational performance.
* Lead a portfolio of key transformation initiatives, including Experience Insights \& Analysis, Pharmacy Experience Program (PEP), Rx Delivery, AI Call Agent and Assisted Data Entry.
* Translate strategic opportunities into scalable solutions, leading initiatives from discovery, concept development and business case through implementation, adoption and value realization.
* Champion a patient\- and team\-centred approach to transformation, ensuring new technology and process changes make pharmacy interactions simpler, more seamless and more meaningful.
* Identify opportunities to redesign, simplify and automate pharmacy workflows, reducing administrative burden and enabling pharmacy teams to spend more time supporting patients and delivering care.
* Use patient feedback, pharmacy team insights, operational data, market trends and emerging technology to identify opportunities and shape the future pharmacy experience.
* Partner closely with Pharmacy Operations, Technology, Digital, Clinical Excellence and other teams to align business priorities, technology capabilities and investment against the transformation roadmap.
* Lead experience discovery and analysis to better understand patient and team member pain points, unmet needs and emerging expectations, and translate those insights into actionable transformation priorities.
* Establish clear success measures across patient experience, pharmacy team experience, operational performance and financial value, and monitor outcomes to ensure initiatives are delivering meaningful impact.
* Build alignment across senior stakeholders and cross\-functional teams, bringing clarity and structure to complex transformation opportunities and driving decisions required to move initiatives forward.
* Lead and develop a high\-performing team with a strong culture of strategic thinking, innovation, experimentation, accountability and execution.

 **What You’ll Need**

* Senior leadership experience in strategy, AI, digital transformation, technology, customer experience or large\-scale business transformation.
* Demonstrated ability to develop transformation strategies and take complex initiatives from concept and business case through implementation and scale.
* Strong understanding of AI, automation and emerging technologies, and how they can be applied to improve customer or patient experience, frontline workflows and operational efficiency.
* Strong strategic thinking and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to bring structure and direction to complex or ambiguous opportunities.
* A strong human\-centred mindset, with demonstrated ability to translate patient, customer and frontline team needs into meaningful experience improvements.
* Strong business acumen, including the ability to assess opportunities, build compelling business cases and connect transformation investments to measurable value.
* Proven ability to lead complex, cross\-functional initiatives across operations, technology, digital and business teams.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to align senior leaders around a transformation agenda.
* Experience using data, insights and performance measures to inform strategy, prioritize opportunities and assess impact.
* Experience in pharmacy, healthcare, retail, technology, consulting or another complex operating environment.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high\-performing teams through significant change and transformation.
* Post\-Secondary education in Industrial or Process Engineer / Technology / Business/ Healthcare or Operations
* 7\-10 years' experience, retail preferred
* MBA or relevant advanced degree is an asset.
* Must be available

jobs.title: AI Product Scaling Director
jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship\-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.


At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.


To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com


**What you'll be doing**

  

Our AI team builds enterprise capabilities that support a wide range of users across the organization, from end users to technology teams and low\-code or no\-code builders. As a Principal Product Scaler – AI Engineering, you'll build the engineering foundation that helps us repeatedly deliver high\-quality AI products safely, efficiently, and at scale. You'll architect and develop the reusable components, software development kits, testing frameworks, and delivery patterns that move us from individual implementations to a mature product engineering model. You'll establish the standards for how AI products are designed, built, tested, packaged, released, and monitored in production. Working closely with data scientists, engineers, and technology partners, you'll help turn strong prototypes into reliable enterprise products while strengthening the team's overall engineering capability.

  

*At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (proportion of on\-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.*

  

**How you'll succeed**

  

* **Build scalable engineering foundations** \- Design and develop software development kits, libraries, reusable components, templates, and reference implementations that accelerate delivery across the AI portfolio and reduce repeated effort across teams.
* **Establish engineering excellence \-** Define and implement standards for code structure, testing, code review, versioning, packaging, documentation, release management, and production readiness for AI and Generative AI products.
* **Advance AI quality and reliability** \- Create automated testing, evaluation, regression, monitoring, and observability patterns that support both traditional software quality and the unique behavior of probabilistic AI systems.
* **Drive efficient delivery** \- Establish continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) patterns, quality gates, and repeatable workflows that help teams move from experiment to production with greater speed and consistency.
* **Enable adoption across teams \-** Design interfaces and developer experiences that make enterprise AI capabilities easy to consume for technology teams, other AI teams, and low\-code or no\-code solution builders.
* **Elevate team capability** \- Review architecture and code for critical products, coach AI practitioners on engineering best practices, and help the team adopt effective agentic development workflows, tooling, and guardrails.
  

**Who you are**

  

* **You are a hands\-on senior engineering leader** . You have atleast 5\+ experience operating at a Staff, Principal, Lead Engineer, or equivalent level, and you enjoy both designing systems and writing production\-quality code.
* **You can demonstrate experience in** system design, application programming interface (API) and software development kit (SDK) design, testing, CI/CD, versioning, observability, and production operations. It’s an asset if you have built platforms, frameworks, developer tooling, or reusable services used by multiple teams.
* **You give meaning to data** . You understand the engineering challenges of taking AI and Generative AI solutions from experimentation into production, and you know that quality for AI systems requires more than traditional unit testing.
* **You look beyond the moment.** You're excited by the opportunity to shape how agentic software development evolves, including workflows, repository design, testing approaches, review practices, context management, and governance for increasingly autonomous delivery.
* **You're motivated by collective success** . You influence engineers, data scientists, technology partners, and leaders through strong partnership, sound judgment, and a commitment to raising the capability of the broader organization.
* **You act like an owner** . You naturally identify repeated patterns, remove friction from the development lifecycle, and build practical solutions that help teams deliver faster, more safely, and with greater consistency.
* **Values matter to you** . You bring your real self to work, and you live our values \- trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**What CIBC Offers**

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.


* We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program\*, defined benefit pension plan\*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points\-based recognition program.
* Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.
* We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

* Subject to plan and program terms and conditions


**What you need to know**

* CIBC is committed to creating an inclusive environment where all team members and clients feel like they belong. We seek applicants with a wide range of abilities and we provide an accessible candidate experience. If you need accommodation, please contact Mailbox.careers\-carrieres@cibc.com

jobs.title: Canada Technology Consulting - Business Platform Transformation Senior Director
jobs.description:
**JOB REQUISITION**

Canada Technology Consulting \- Business Platform Transformation Senior Director
**LOCATION**

VANCOUVER
**ADDITIONAL LOCATION(S)**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**You Belong Here**

The Protiviti Career provides an opportunity to learn, inspire, and advance within a collaborative and inclusive culture. We hire curious individuals for whom learning is a passion. We lean into our mission: We Care. We Collaborate. We Deliver.


At every level, we champion leaders who live our values of integrity, inclusion, innovation, and commitment to success. Imagining our work as a journey, we believe integrity guides our way, inclusion moves us forward together, innovation creates new destinations, and our commitment to success empowers us to deliver on our vision to be the most trusted global consulting firm.  



  

  

**Where We Need You:**

The Technology Consulting Practice is seeking a Senior Director to join our growing team and lead client transformation across the Quote to Cash ecosystem, including Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ), Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), billing, order management, revenue recognition, and broader revenue operations transformation. Quote to Cash has become the operational backbone of modern revenue models, requiring organizations to connect commercial strategy, technology architecture, process design, data integrity, and delivery excellence. Subscription pricing, usage\-based billing, complex contracting, and AI\-accelerated deal cycles require a leader who can help clients modernize how revenue is designed, sold, contracted, billed, recognized, and optimized.  



  

  

**What You Can Expect:**

This is a practice\-building leadership role with responsibility for advancing the firm’s Quote to Cash transformation capabilities across market positioning, client advisory, technology partner alignment, delivery methodology, talent development, and commercial and delivery performance. The Senior Director will help define how the firm goes to market, how client transformation engagements are shaped and delivered, which technology partners are prioritized, and how the practice creates measurable value for clients across the Q2C ecosystem.  



  

  

**What Will Help You Be Successful:**

* Define and evolve the firm’s Q2C practice vision, service portfolio, go\-to\-market strategy, priority client segments, and market differentiation.
* Originate and support client opportunities in partnership with sales leadership, including serving as the senior SME in pursuits, proposals, RFPs, and executive client conversations.
* Build the firm’s market presence through thought leadership, speaking opportunities, webinars, analyst relationships, and other external visibility channels.
* Lead or sponsor the most complex Q2C advisory and implementation engagements, providing credible executive guidance across business process, architecture, platform selection, integration, and post\-go\-live optimization.
* Design scalable Q2C operating models across CPQ, contract lifecycle, recurring and usage\-based billing, order management, revenue recognition, accounts receivable, data, and analytics.
* Establish and maintain strategic alliances with key technology partners, including Salesforce, Zuora, Oracle, Stripe, Logi Sense, Conga, Docusign, and other Q2C ecosystem providers.
* Create and standardize delivery methodology, frameworks, assessment tools, accelerators, reference architectures, and reusable assets that improve quality, consistency, and practitioner leverage.
* Recruit, develop, and retain a high\-performing team of Q2C advisors and technology practitioners, while building competency models, career paths, certification plans, and mentoring routines.
* Own practice health and performance indicators, including revenue, pipeline coverage, utilization, realization, client satisfaction, delivery quality, and profitability.
Partner with firm leadership on workforce planning, investment priorities, market trends, and strategic growth decisions as the practice scales.  
* 

  

  

**Do Your Talents Include the Following?**

* Deep Quote to Cash domain expertise across product and pricing catalogues, CPQ workflows, contract execution and amendments, billing models, order management, revenue recognition under ASC 606 / IFRS 15, and accounts receivable.
* Hands\-on mastery of Salesforce Revenue Cloud / CPQ, with credible cross\-platform fluency across the broader Q2C ecosystem, including Zuora, Oracle CPQ, Stripe Billing, Conga CLM, DocuSign CLM, or comparable platforms.
* Ability to advise clients on platform selection, solution architecture, integration patterns, vendor considerations, and technology tradeoffs across CRM, ERP, revenue recognition, billing, CLM, iPaaS, analytics, and RevOps tooling.
* Demonstrated success designing and delivering end\-to\-end Q2C transformations, from current\-state assessment and business case development through implementation, integration, change management, and optimization.
* Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with CFOs, RevOps leaders, CIOs, sales executives, and technical architects.
* Commercial orientation, with the ability to connect technology decisions to business outcomes such as revenue leakage, deal velocity, DSO, audit readiness, margin realization, and client value.
* Experience building or scaling a consulting practice, service line, or equivalent capability, including offering development, pipeline building, delivery oversight, team development, and P\&L\-oriented decision\-making.
* Experience leading multi\-workstream, multimillion\-dollar advisory or implementation programs and managing senior client relationships.
* Builder’s mentality, analytical rigor, and platform\-neutral integrity, with a bias for creating durable methodology, team capability, and market position.
* Existing or buildable relationships within the Q2C technology partner ecosystem.
* Exposure to

jobs.title: Director - Retail Project Management (Enterprise)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Turner \& Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.


Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.


Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.


We are majority\-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner \& Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.


As a Turner \& Townsend Project Management Director, you’ll be responsible for client management and department\-related management services within multiple geographic markets, programs, and asset classes to achieve the company's strategic business objectives by delivering outstanding results to our client.


This job is part of the Enterprise Project Management division. They are responsible for the management of projects from initiation through completion for dedicated client groups as part of a multi\-service outsourcing contract. You will be responsible for global teams delivering commercial office fit\-out, retail and Move Adds \& Change services.

**Who are you?**


You are an expert **Real Estate** **Project Management Director** **with a minimum of 12\+** **years post\-graduate experience** **in real estate project management** looking for the next step or are currently undertaking a similar role in a similar environment.

 **Job Description**  

* Communicate with the client and manage client expectations on resourcing needs, project and programme performance, risks, status reporting, and issues escalation
* Direct all phases of the delivery process for large and high\-profile clients including procurement, contracting, planning, tracking, and execution
* Provide formal supervision to direct report employees in Canada, the US and EMEA. Monitor the training and development of staff. Conduct performance evaluations and coaching. Oversee the recruiting and hiring of new employees.
* Coordinate and manage the team's daily activities. Establish work schedules, assign tasks, and cross\-train staff. Set and track staff and department deadlines. Mentor and coach as needed.
* Ensure that contract procurement, negotiation, execution, administration, and closeouts are accurate, timely, and compliant.
* Develop new business growth and maintain existing business relationships.
* Maintain full responsibility for the financial performance of market, program, and client accounts.
* Identify complex project risks, lead reviews, and develop risk mitigation and backup plans.
* Apply deep knowledge of multiple disciplines, broad industry knowledge, and commercial awareness. Drive financial and functional performance within disciplines and across business.
* Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with Turner \& Townsend values. Negotiate with senior management, customers, and external parties of divergent interests to reach an agreement of strategic importance while being guided by the business segment and the organization's functional strategy.
* Conceptualize new methods, techniques, processes, and standards across job disciplines or functions.
* Direct the resolution of highly complex or unusual business problems by applying advanced critical thinking.
* Work in partnership with the Account Alliance Director, Facility Management teams, Transaction teams, Procurement and other teams to provide a fully integrated and seamless service.
* Ensure that all account KPI’s and SLA’s are achieved.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's Degree preferred with 12\-15 years of relevant real estate project delivery experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered. LEED AP, PMP, and/or CCM designation(s) preferred.
* Polished communicator with experience presenting and liaising with client executive and C\-Suite level employees.
* In\-depth knowledge of financial terms and principles and the ability to analyze the most complex business/financial data and develop innovative solutions.
* Experience in the areas of staffing, selection, training, development, coaching, mentoring, measuring, appraising, and rewarding performance and retention is preferred.
* Ability to exchange sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations and handle problems.
* Leadership skills to motivate the team to achieve broad operational targets with impacts on own job discipline, multiple job disciplines, and department.
* In\-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Expert organizational skills with an unrivaled inquisitive mindset.
* Ideally you have **retail** project delivery experience and experience with clients/organizations in the financial and professional services sector.

  

**Additional Information** **What's in it for you...**

* 100% covered health and dental benefits for you and your dependents (including paramedical services)
* Health spending account, to top up expenses not covered in the benefits program
* RRSP option with company matching
* Annual learning and development budget
* Access to a range of online learning tools, and support for career development and growth
* Coverage of one professional membership or license fee per year, if directly related to your role
* We believe in work\-life balance, so you can recharge and take care of what matters most with vacation, flex and sick days
* A flexible, hybrid

jobs.title: Associate Director, Capital Investment Strategy
jobs.description:
**Toronto Pearson is transforming. Now’s the time for your career to fly.**



The Greater Toronto Airports Authority (GTAA) is a unique and dynamic place to work, with a bold plan to make Toronto Pearson, Canada’s leading global hub airport, a global leader in airport performance, customer care and sustainability. Together with our partners, approximately 2,100 GTAA employees are working to create a next\-generation airport by innovating in all we do and striving for the most uplifting, safe and efficient experience for our passengers – all while championing the prosperity of our people, the community we call home, and our aviation partners. Join us on our journey together, as we put the joy back into travel and make Toronto Pearson the chosen place to fly and work.


**What's in it for you?**


* An opportunity to grow, develop, and thrive within a dynamic, and fast\-growing company alongside thoughtful and passionate individuals dedicated to their work and community.
* Comprehensive benefits, including a flexible retirement program with employer matching, along with voluntary savings options (RRSP, TFSA, and Non\-Registered Savings Plans).
* A flexible hybrid work environment, continuous internal and external learning opportunities, and a meaningful reward and recognition program.


**What can you expect from this position?**



Reporting to the Executive Director, Capital Planning, the Associate Director, Capital Investment Strategy will lead the Capital Investments function and help determine where and why Toronto Pearson invests. You will provide financial leadership across the front end of the capital investment lifecycle by supporting strategic initiative business cases, portfolio prioritization, project intake, investment governance, and benefits realization. Working with business units, the Transformation Office, Strategy, Finance business partners, and program teams, you will translate strategic priorities into decision\-ready investment recommendations for executive consideration. You will establish consistent methodologies, standards, and controls so that capital investments are strategically aligned, financially sound, affordable, and supported by reliable data and robust business intelligence.


**As an Associate Director, Capital Investment Strategy, you will:**


* Lead the development and financial evaluation of business cases for major strategic initiatives, while establishing the standards and methodologies applied across the broader capital portfolio.
* Develop complex financial models incorporating NPV, IRR, ROIC, cash flow, sensitivity, scenario, and risk\-adjusted investment analyses.
* Challenge assumptions and translate complex analysis into decision\-ready recommendations for executive and Board\-level consideration.
* Lead quarterly financial forecasting and reporting for multi\-year strategic initiatives.
* Support the enterprise capital allocation and prioritization process with a multidisciplinary team, applying consistent strategic, financial, affordability, risk, and delivery\-capacity criteria to recommend investments, sequencing decisions, trade\-offs, and off\-ramp actions to executive governance forums.
* Establish and maintain enterprise investment\-governance standards, including business\-case methodologies and templates, evaluation criteria, capital allocation frameworks, hurdle rates, risk premiums, stage\-gate requirements, and decision records that support consistent and transparent recommendations.
* Lead the enterprise project intake and triage process partnering with the appropriate teams to confirm strategic alignment, scope maturity, resource capacity, accounting treatment, funding pathway, and business\-case requirements before investments advance for prioritization or approval.
* Establish benefits and cost baselines for approved investments, integrate expected outcomes into portfolio planning, monitor realization across all programs, and lead post\-investment evaluations that identify variances, lessons learned, and implications for future capital allocation decisions.
* Support the evaluation of public\-private partnerships and alternative delivery models, including financial returns, affordability, financing approaches, and risk allocation.
* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing team while fostering accountability, collaboration, analytical excellence, and continuous improvement.


**This is the role for you, if you have:**

* A university degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* A CPA, CFA, CBV, MBA, or other relevant professional designation or graduate degree is considered an asset.
* Five or more years of relevant experience in investment analysis, corporate finance, infrastructure finance, business\-case development, portfolio planning, or major capital programs, including experience leading complex, cross\-functional investment decisions in a leadership capacity.
* Advanced expertise in financial modelling, scenario analysis, sensitivity testing, and investment evaluation methodologies.
* Expertise in developing decision\-ready business cases for major strategic or capital initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience designing or operating capital allocation, project intake, stage\-gate, investment\-governance, or benefits\-realization processes across a complex portfolio.
* Experience evaluating public\-private partnerships or alternative capital\-project delivery and financing models.
* Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across senior leadership and business functions.
* Strong executive communication skills and the ability to translate complex financial analysis into clear business implications and recommendations.
* Strategic thinking, sound judgement, and strong problem\-solving and decision\-making capabilities.
* Experience leading, coaching, and developing finance professionals in a collaborative environment.

new_jobs.title: AI Product Scaling Director
new_jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship\-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.


At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.


To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com


**What you'll be doing**

  

Our AI team builds enterprise capabilities that support a wide range of users across the organization, from end users to technology teams and low\-code or no\-code builders. As a Principal Product Scaler – AI Engineering, you'll build the engineering foundation that helps us repeatedly deliver high\-quality AI products safely, efficiently, and at scale. You'll architect and develop the reusable components, software development kits, testing frameworks, and delivery patterns that move us from individual implementations to a mature product engineering model. You'll establish the standards for how AI products are designed, built, tested, packaged, released, and monitored in production. Working closely with data scientists, engineers, and technology partners, you'll help turn strong prototypes into reliable enterprise products while strengthening the team's overall engineering capability.

  

*At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (proportion of on\-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.*

  

**How you'll succeed**

  

* **Build scalable engineering foundations** \- Design and develop software development kits, libraries, reusable components, templates, and reference implementations that accelerate delivery across the AI portfolio and reduce repeated effort across teams.
* **Establish engineering excellence \-** Define and implement standards for code structure, testing, code review, versioning, packaging, documentation, release management, and production readiness for AI and Generative AI products.
* **Advance AI quality and reliability** \- Create automated testing, evaluation, regression, monitoring, and observability patterns that support both traditional software quality and the unique behavior of probabilistic AI systems.
* **Drive efficient delivery** \- Establish continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) patterns, quality gates, and repeatable workflows that help teams move from experiment to production with greater speed and consistency.
* **Enable adoption across teams \-** Design interfaces and developer experiences that make enterprise AI capabilities easy to consume for technology teams, other AI teams, and low\-code or no\-code solution builders.
* **Elevate team capability** \- Review architecture and code for critical products, coach AI practitioners on engineering best practices, and help the team adopt effective agentic development workflows, tooling, and guardrails.
  

**Who you are**

  

* **You are a hands\-on senior engineering leader** . You have atleast 5\+ experience operating at a Staff, Principal, Lead Engineer, or equivalent level, and you enjoy both designing systems and writing production\-quality code.
* **You can demonstrate experience in** system design, application programming interface (API) and software development kit (SDK) design, testing, CI/CD, versioning, observability, and production operations. It’s an asset if you have built platforms, frameworks, developer tooling, or reusable services used by multiple teams.
* **You give meaning to data** . You understand the engineering challenges of taking AI and Generative AI solutions from experimentation into production, and you know that quality for AI systems requires more than traditional unit testing.
* **You look beyond the moment.** You're excited by the opportunity to shape how agentic software development evolves, including workflows, repository design, testing approaches, review practices, context management, and governance for increasingly autonomous delivery.
* **You're motivated by collective success** . You influence engineers, data scientists, technology partners, and leaders through strong partnership, sound judgment, and a commitment to raising the capability of the broader organization.
* **You act like an owner** . You naturally identify repeated patterns, remove friction from the development lifecycle, and build practical solutions that help teams deliver faster, more safely, and with greater consistency.
* **Values matter to you** . You bring your real self to work, and you live our values \- trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**What CIBC Offers**

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.


* We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program\*, defined benefit pension plan\*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points\-based recognition program.
* Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.
* We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

* Subject to plan and program terms and conditions
